page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c1 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical CPU cores with 8 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server type does not include bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage attachment for operating system and application deployment. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses allocated to this instance.

The underlying CPU architecture lacks support for several modern instruction set extensions. Specifically, Advanced Vector Extensions, Advanced Matrix Extensions, and hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions are unavailable. The absence of hyperthreading and these vector extensions represents a significant tradeoff for workloads requiring dense parallel floating-point calculations or cryptographic processing.

Given the 1:1 ratio of memory to vCPUs and the dedicated core allocation, the ecs.c1.small is structured for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints. It is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight batch processing, and legacy application hosting where dedicated CPU execution is preferred over shared-core burstable models.
